Cc: LedgerPay Ops <ops@ledgerpay.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T01:12:00+08:00
Subject: URGENT: Night outage during APAC launch - request for P1 standby

Kim -

We just hit a cascading error during the first midnight traffic burst for our APAC rollout. For ~18 minutes our tokenization service saw elevated 500s when traffic spiked at 00:45 SGT; our telemetry shows 30% higher latency and a handful of customer-facing failures. We're in the middle of a staged feature flip for 2M monthly users and we need immediate operational support.

Can Redwood stand up a temporary P1 on-call (dedicated responder + escalation path) for the next 72 hours? Specifically:
- Dedicated primary on-call (phone + Slack) reachable at all hours from 00:00 SGT today through 23:59 SGT on 2028-06-20.
- An escalation ladder (primary -> secondary -> engineering manager -> site reliability lead) with expected response windows of 15m / 30m / 60m respectively.
- A named contact to coordinate live rollbacks/traffic-shifts.

We understand there may be fees or credits; we are happy to sign an amendment but need the operational guarantee to avoid customer-impact. I've attached our launch runbook and will make the execs available if needed.

Nate
Nate Morris
Head of Platform
LedgerPay

2) Secondary responder (phone/SMS/Slack @laura_bennett) - 30 min
